cheats.title: Nice Try, Hackerman
cheats.joke: You posted an achievement by hand. The service checked. It said no.
cheats.when: the achievements service rejects a forged or unsigned event from this student

cheats.title: Trust Issues
cheats.joke: You edited the check tool. It noticed.
cheats.when: the hash of `dojo-check` sent with a check does not match the shipped one

cheats.title: Identity Crisis
cheats.joke: You are not who you said you were.
cheats.when: a request carries another student's identity headers (gateway/service token mismatch)

cheats.title: Button Masher
cheats.joke: The check button is not a slot machine.
cheats.when: the rate limit on `dojo-check` is hit

cheats.title: Oops, You Bumped Into Your Neighbour
cheats.when: a refused request into another student's space (first time, looks accidental)

cheats.title: Curiosity Killed the Cat
cheats.when: repeated or deliberate refused requests into another student's space

cheats.title: Persistent, Aren't You
cheats.when: keeps going after Curiosity Killed the Cat
